payload.title: Readiness counts the last five stable SHADOW runs and judges freshness by age only, and parse_window_signature, documented as the key for whether a recorded run still matches the declaration, hashes only default_input.roots and has no comparing reader, so runs recorded before a default-input change (221 findings) count for the changed tool (349).
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/tool_registry.py:897-924 (the signature hashes scope, claim types, roots and globs only)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/tool_registry.py:121-130 (the trigger set includes the whole default_input, the hash does not)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/readiness.py:40-41 (all runs of the tool id are read and the last five taken with no declaration filter)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/readiness.py:53 (the stable-run count is taken over those five)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/readiness.py:114-129 (freshness is run age against the window; the comment says the parse window may have moved and nothing compares it)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/adapter_portfolio.py:19-23 (documents the signature as the way the kernel decides a SHADOW run is stale)
tools/aria-adapters/test-gap-adapter.tool.json:23-26 (coverageRoots is a default input key that is outside the signature)
payload.rule_violated: Evidence must be about the thing it promotes (readiness.py:114-119 states the intent that SHADOW evidence cannot justify promotion once the parse window moved); the signature is documented as that key but is not enforced anywhere.
payload.notes: PR #2150 changes the default emission of test-gap-adapter from 221 to 349 findings by deleting an input flag; the signature and the manifest version stay the same, and adapter_active_readiness reads runs[-5:] of the tool without any check of what default input or rule set produced them. Five stable runs recorded with the rule off therefore clear fewer_than_5_shadow_runs and last_5_runs_not_stable for the rule-on tool, and a change of coverageRoots (which decides which specs count as coverage) is invisible to the signature. Promotion still needs operator approval and precision is already scoped to the current emission, so the wrong evidence is one input to a human decision. Close condition: Record a declaration identity (tool_manifest_hash, or a signature over the whole default_input and rule set) on each run row and make adapter_active_readiness count only runs whose recorded identity equals the current one; pin with a readiness test in which five stable runs recorded under a different default_input yield fewer_than_5_shadow_runs. Plan row: DET detector program (landing batch 4). Verified at origin/main d716541239.
